idea-plugin.name: KompozR
idea-plugin.description:
For KompozR's UI code, written in Kotlin's syntax: inside kompoz! { … } blocks of Rust sources and in whole .kt files read by kompoz_file!. KompozR's language server, kompoz-lsp, answers for the Kotlin in RustRover and CLion: the generator's errors on the Kotlin's own lines (and rustc's, through its shadow-project bridge), hovers, completion, going to definitions, and its colors for the Kotlin. The IDE's own Rust support keeps the Rust around it. .kt files are highlighted with a Kotlin grammar of the plugin's (TextMate).

kompoz-lsp is found in Settings, Tools, KompozR, else in KOMPOZ_LSP, built in the project's target/, on PATH or in ~/.cargo/bin.
